summary: North kerb backing onto bush, but homes 16-20 m across a narrow road.
reasons: Narrow road, tight room to stop

best_section.where: North kerb of Goldieslie Road just past the corner, where a car is already parked

drivers.seclusion: Dense bush on the north side; houses and pools sit 16-29 m away across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed road with a car already parked at the north edge near the start; width beyond that looks tight with bush at the edge.
drivers.traffic: Quiet street ending at bush, local traffic only.
drivers.convention: One or two cars parked at the north kerb near the corner; 2P Mon-Fri 9am-5pm sign only restricts daytime.

flags: Steep: about 3.8% fall along the section, 8.2% max
Homes within about 25 m on the opposite side
sun_shade: Shaded by bush canopy from the north; open to afternoon sun from the west near the corner.
